claims.quote: the possibilities of atomic energy that Holsten had opened for mankind
claims.description: Atomic energy is harnessed for practical and military use after a scientist's discovery.

claims.quote: the swift aeroplane, with its atomic engine as noiseless as a dancing sunbeam and its phosphorescent gyroscopic compass
claims.description: Aircraft powered by silent atomic engines and guided by a gyroscopic compass.

claims.quote: Never before in the history of warfare had there been a continuing explosive
claims.description: Atomic bombs that explode continuously for days or years rather than instantly.

claims.quote: What the earlier twentieth-century chemists called its half period was seventeen days
claims.description: An artificial radioactive element with a half-life of seventeen days that decays in a self-sustaining chain.

claims.quote: the bomb spread itself out into a monstrous cavern of fiery energy at the base of what became very speedily a miniature active volcano.
claims.description: An atomic bomb buries itself and turns the impact site into a long-lasting erupting crater.

claims.quote: to this day the battle-fields and bomb fields of that frantic time in human history are sprinkled with radiant matter, and so centres of inconvenient rays
claims.description: Atomic war leaves lasting radioactive contamination of battlefields.

claims.quote: Marshal Dubois, in consultation with General Viard and the Earl of Delhi, was to play the great game for world supremacy against the Central European powers.
claims.description: A general European war between the Allies and the Central European powers, directed from Paris.
claims.stated_time: the night of July the second

claims.quote: At every convenient place upon the line on either side of the Channel Tunnel there were enthusiastic spectators
claims.description: A railway tunnel under the English Channel is in operation and carries troop trains.

claims.quote: Before the last war began it was a matter of common knowledge that a man could carry about in a handbag an amount of latent energy sufficient to wreck half a city.
claims.description: Portable devices carrying enough energy to destroy half a city.

claims.quote: nothing could have been more obvious to the people of the earlier twentieth century than the rapidity with which war was becoming impossible
claims.description: Growing destructive power makes large-scale war untenable.

claims.quote: Collective civilisation, the ‘Modern State,’ was still in the womb of the future
claims.description: A future organized world state will replace the aimless social organization of the early twentieth century.
